title: FluxNode Beat-Palmier MVP
mission: Ship the fastest MVP that competes with Palmier Pro only at a better level: categorical wins on axes Palmier structurally cannot follow, parity on table stakes.

killer_features.name: Zero-Credit Studio
killer_features.summary: Local on-GPU generation: image (sd.cpp fast path + ComfyUI power path), TTS (piper), STT (whisper); GpuArbiter VRAM eviction; unlimited regenerate, offline, $0/clip.
killer_features.moat: Palmier's revenue IS metered cloud credits; no local backend layer exists in their architecture.

killer_features.name: Built-in Offline Copilot
killer_features.summary: In-app chat panel driving the 30-action registry via local Ollama (default qwen3.5:4b), tool-activity feed, propose-confirm write flow; MCP still exposed for external agents.
killer_features.moat: Palmier ships no brain of its own; it requires the user's paid Claude/Codex/Cursor.

killer_features.name: Regeneration-Safe Pipeline
killer_features.summary: Prompt/model/seed pinned to clips as node data; regenerate-in-place with duration-lock policy; NLE XML export + generation-metadata sidecar with lossless re-import.
killer_features.moat: Attacks Palmier's two documented weaknesses: metadata loss on export and regen duration drift; requires clips-as-nodes semantics.

waves.name: Sidecar Foundation
waves.ships: whisper/piper/sd.cpp fetch scripts per-OS, flag verification against real binaries, model downloader with checksums, CI proof on 3 OS; llama.cpp stub removed from scope.

waves.name: Copilot Surface
waves.ships: Chat panel (src/features/copilot/) on agent_chat, tool-activity feed, propose-confirm flow for Mutating/LongJob, model picker + Ollama health check, --mcp runtime-verified.

waves.name: Zero-Credit Studio
waves.ships: Generate-image node E2E via sd.cpp + ComfyUI, TTS/STT surfaced in UI, timeline insert of generated assets, GpuArbiter eviction verified under real VRAM pressure.

waves.name: Transcribe & Find
waves.ships: Whisper transcription job + UI, transcript store, transcript search across project media, 16kHz ffmpeg pre-convert.

waves.name: Regen-Safe Pipeline
waves.ships: Regen metadata on clips/nodes, regenerate-in-place with duration-lock, NLE XML (FCP7) export + generation-metadata sidecar + lossless re-import.

waves.name: Beta Hardening
waves.ships: Cross-OS release proof (macOS/Linux bundle targets + fetch scripts), perf pass vs hardware tiers, killer-feature onboarding, beta packaging + docs.

milestones.name: Table stakes closed

milestones.proof: Duration-locked regen with intact cuts; export/re-import round-trip preserves regen; >=2 axes Strong-vs-Absent in our favor, 0 against on table stakes
